_about: Which surface each building part gets. First matching slot wins. A slot has either 'set' (a folder here with diff.jpg = colour sRGB, nor.jpg = OpenGL normal map, arm.jpg = R ambient occlusion / G roughness / B metalness; tileM = real-world size of one repeat in metres) or 'paint' (plain colour with roughness / metalness, no texture). 'match' is a regular expression on the part name from factory_precision.obj. Colours follow the site photos of 2026-11-09 (docs/SITE_REFERENCE_2026-11-09.md). To use a Megascans surface: export it as the three files into a new folder and change 'set'.

lighting._note: site: round high-bay LEDs, cool white (about 5000 K)
